title: Thumbnails, media API dimensions and pre-sized gallery containers for a self-hosted media vault
derivation: Private media-vault PR #8 (thumbnail generation function storing original dimensions in blob metadata, media-list API returning thumbnailUrl/width/height, carousel using thumbnails with pre-sized containers and full-size fullscreen) re-synthesized as sanitized framework-free JavaScript modules over an in-memory blob store with injected probe/resize. No private code, event names, URLs or media are included. v2 (MB-010c follow-up, native admission finding, benchmarks/michael/curriculum/MB-010r-emv-thumbnails-gallery-admission.json sha256 856d048b467d79464dc5384246a819406a5767f92cb151aebf0343b6212e0cc1): the instruction said the carousel keeps height, but oracle and checks set height to rowHeight; and it claimed full per-image failure isolation, but store.exists runs outside the per-image try/catch so an existence-check error rejects the run. The instruction now describes both behaviors. Oracle and hidden checks are unchanged.
coverage: Backend thumbnail pipeline (planning, orientation, failure isolation, skip/force, metadata), API contract and gallery layout across three files, on held-out albums.
historical_exposure: Private history; synthetic fixture has low recognition risk.
residual_rubric: Visual layout quality and spinner UX are not graded.
